snapshot.title: PLC-02 Program Integrity Check Failed — Backup Gap

lines.msg: PLC-02 program integrity check failed. Hash mismatch: expected 3a7f2c9d, found 1b4e5a2c.
Backup source MDWS-BKP-PLC-02-032025 (March 2025) does not match current live PLC-02 program.
No verified backup of PLC-02 program exists from after 08/2025. The 08/2025 flow-pacing revision was never archived.
Current live program is stored only on PLC-02 and on user laptop MBW-DEV-LT01 (jmolina@millbrook-oh.example).
Initiate recovery via OHWARN under Section 11.3. No newer backup exists. Do not attempt manual reload.
Audit trail confirms no access to PLC-02 from external network. No unauthorized session detected.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject reveals a critical gap in the backup strategy for the hypochlorite feed control logic. The IT team must immediately initiate recovery via OHWARN, as no up-to-date backup exists. Watch for delays in escalation or confusion over the recovery path.
